subject: ss-medical-oncology
title: Metastatic colorectal cancer: molecular profiling, targeted biologics and surgical resection

steps.tx: Comprehensive molecular profiling is critical before initiating targeted therapy for advanced bowel cancer. Testing for **Extended RAS** mutations across KRAS and NRAS exons 2, 3, and 4 alongside **BRAF V600E** mutations guides systemic treatment selection. Tumours harbouring activating mutations in either KRAS, NRAS, or BRAF demonstrate complete intrinsic resistance to monoclonal antibodies targeting EGFR, making molecular characterisation mandatory prior to prescribing anti-EGFR therapy.

rows: Indicates poor prognosis, needs BRAF TKI

steps.tx: Primary **tumour sidedness** serves as a vital surrogate for biological heterogeneity and dictates frontline therapeutic efficacy. Patients with **left-sided** primary tumours arising from the splenic flexure to rectum derive substantial overall survival advantages when treated with anti-EGFR antibodies **cetuximab** or **panitumumab** combined with doublet chemotherapy. Conversely, right-sided RAS wild-type neoplasms show minimal responsiveness to anti-EGFR biologics in the frontline setting.

left.title: Left-Sided Tumours
points: Higher frequency of HER2 and EGFR sensitivity
Substantial benefit from cetuximab or panitumumab

right.title: Right-Sided Tumours
points: Higher rates of BRAF and MSI-H alterations
Primary benefit derived from bevacizumab doublets

steps.tx: For **Right-sided** metastatic colorectal cancer, frontline biological therapy primarily focuses on VEGF blockade. The vascular endothelial growth factor monoclonal antibody **bevacizumab** combined with **cytotoxic doublets** like FOLFOX or FOLFIRI, or triplet FOLFOXIRI, produces superior clinical outcomes compared to anti-EGFR regimens. Angiogenesis inhibition circumvents the EGFR resistance characteristic of right-sided embryological origin, delivering prolonged disease control.
steps.say: In patients with Right-sided metastatic colorectal cancer, frontline biological therapy targets VEGF-mediated tumour angiogenesis. The vascular endothelial growth factor monoclonal antibody bevacizumab combined with cytotoxic doublets like FOLFOX or FOLFIRI produces superior clinical outcomes compared to anti-EGFR regimens. Inhibition of tumour angiogenesis helps bypass intrinsic epidermal growth factor receptor resistance.

steps.tx: The **BEACON CRC** phase 3 trial established a dedicated targeted standard of care for pretreated **BRAF V600E** mutant metastatic colorectal cancer. Combining the oral BRAF inhibitor **encorafenib** with the anti-EGFR antibody **cetuximab** significantly prolonged overall survival compared to standard chemotherapy. Dual vertical blockade of both BRAF and EGFR prevents rapid feedback activation of the MAPK signaling cascade, yielding meaningful and durable tumour regressions.

left.title: Encorafenib + Cetuximab
points: Dual vertical MAPK and EGFR inhibition

steps.tx: Microsatellite instability-high or mismatch repair-deficient colorectal tumours demonstrate marked sensitivity to immune checkpoint blockade. In the landmark **KEYNOTE-177** trial, frontline monotherapy with **pembrolizumab** demonstrated remarkable superiority in progression-free survival compared to standard chemotherapy doublets with targeted biologics. Patients treated with pembrolizumab achieved durable long-term responses and fewer treatment-related adverse events.

steps.tx: In refractory metastatic disease following oxaliplatin and irinotecan failure, the **SUNLIGHT trial** introduced an effective combination regimen. Adding **bevacizumab** to **Trifluridine-tipiracil** produced statistically significant and clinically meaningful improvements in progression-free and overall survival compared to trifluridine-tipiracil monotherapy. The combination preserves performance status and exhibits a manageable safety profile dominated by reversible neutropenia.

steps.tx: **Fruquintinib** is an oral, highly selective tyrosine kinase inhibitor of VEGFR 1, 2, and 3 that inhibits tumour neo-angiogenesis. In the international phase 3 **FRESCO-2** trial, fruquintinib significantly extended overall survival in heavily pretreated refractory metastatic colorectal cancer patients who had progressed on standard therapies. The drug provides a vital oral therapeutic option with hypertension and hand-foot skin reaction being manageable side effects.

steps.tx: Aggressive multidisciplinary surgical management plays a curative role in patients presenting with isolated colorectal **liver metastases**. Complete **surgical resection** or thermal ablation of resectable hepatic metastases achieves 5 year overall survival rates reaching 40% to 50% in properly selected candidates. Perioperative cytotoxic chemotherapy further consolidates long-term disease-free survival, converting initially unresectable lesions into candidates for curative surgical resection.
